name: Kawahara Shouko
source:
She is an office worker at the same company as Rika. She is a complex person who lacks self-confidence and is timid about everything.

Her lack of self-confidence is reflected in her outward appearance, and she often wears plain clothes.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=397805]getchu[/url]]
